title: Staff engineer on an industrial condition-monitoring solution
summary: Promoted to staff software engineer, I built middleware for an industry solution that spots failure symptoms in high-value plant assets, and led the team's invention mining.
what_would_have_happened: The new center of excellence would have lacked a single owner for its middleware and team tooling.
the_call: Own the middleware component and the team's practices, not just my code.
what_i_did: Owned middleware and integration services, ran Scrum for the 2011 deliveries, owned the team's tooling and led sessions that mined inventions from the team's work.
what_changed: The team submitted 3 invention disclosures, 5 internal conference abstracts and 2 internship ideas.
